shown.head: Part 5 · Sit still enough to hear it
shown.alt: PART 5 Sit still enough to hear it When you're able to sit with yourself in the stillness of your own mind, you actually start to see how crazy the world is around you. The heart speaks in truth when all is silent so a mind that does not too wish to hear truth will be loud and boisterous.

shown.alt: PART 6 Contentment, the only destination I don't want peace to be at the end of it all. It doesn't make sense. I want peace now. I will choose to be peaceful now until the day I die.
